object.attr: derived: following an object again on each path that reaches it grows exponentially with shared objects, and a crafted repository stops the GUI or the MCP server (CF-T47). A shortest path, so that the depth limit cuts no object a shorter path reaches (requirements review Q14). Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: When a trace reaches one object by several paths, Mellon shall follow the object's links on a shortest of those paths only, and mark the object as shown already on the others.
